title: Lumino's additional lights
description: Adds some custom lights. Best used with a CTM mod.
body:
Adds some custom lights with crafting recipies for building:

- Neon lights in all coulours.
![All neon lights blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0dc73bb678532795e861c666a21a565a0825e59a.png)
- maybe more later on...

currently pretty small and missing translations (currently english only). But I might add more languages later on.
